_readme: UPGRADE_PLAN_V6 C3 (2026-11-15): achievements. name = the badge title; how = what to do (shown to the player, so they know how to earn it); kind = explore / skill / outcome; icon = the shape drawn on the badge (star, planet, rocket, heart, drop, wind, book, camera, person, wrench, skull, trophy); color = the badge color. Achievements named after a real astronaut point at a true fact in data/crew.json. Saved on this computer (user://achievements.json). toast_seconds = how long the pop-up stays.

met_ride.name: Ride Along
met_ride.how: Talk to Sally Ride on the ship (Venus mission).

met_koch.name: 328 Days
met_koch.how: Talk to Christina Koch on the ship (Moon mission).

met_glover.name: Pilot Around the Moon
